label: Claude Pro
models: Claude Fable (via paid usage credits only)
limits: "More usage than Free, every 5 hours and every week*" (pricing page). "Your activity across Claude on web, desktop, mobile, and Claude Code all draws from the same pool." Max is "5x Pro usage" and Ultra "10x Pro usage every week".
notes: Annual: $200 billed up front ($17/mo). Claude Code docs say OAuth is 'designed to support ordinary use of Claude Code and other native Anthropic applications', and 'Anthropic does not permit third-party developers to offer Claude.ai login into their own applications, or to route requests through Free, Pro, Max, or Ultra plan credentials'. Usage credits (overage) are available on paid plans. The pricing page shows Fable as 'Usage credits' for Pro, meaning it isn't covered by the included allowance.

label: Claude Max
models: Claude Fable (capped at 50% of weekly limits)
limits: "5x Pro usage every 5 hours and every week*" (pricing page). Help center: "Get five times the Pro plan's usage every five hours and every week." Fable: "Fable included, up to half your weekly limit".
notes: Called Max 5x until 2026-10-30, when Anthropic renamed it Max; the plan id keeps the old name. Billed monthly only. Includes $100/month in Claude Platform API credits ("$100 a month in API credits to build on the Claude Platform"). Secondary reports say the credits do not pay for Claude Code sessions or usage credits, but they can be spent from any harness via an API key. Mobile pricing may differ. Same third-party OAuth restriction as Pro.

label: Claude Ultra
models: Claude Fable (capped at 50% of weekly limits)
limits: "No 5-hour limit‡" and "10x Pro usage every week*"; "‡No 5-hour limit for verified accounts." Fable: "50% of weekly limits*".
notes: Max 20x was renamed Ultra on 2026-10-30, with automatic migration; the plan id keeps the old name. The old page gave "20x Pro" per 5-hour session; the new one gives the weekly multiple, 10x. Secondary reports say Anthropic left weekly limits unchanged, so this restates the plan rather than cutting it. New accounts get a temporary 5-hour limit until verified. Includes "$200 a month in API credits, up from $100 on Max". Monthly billing only; mobile pricing may differ. Mythos appears in site nav but isn't listed in any plan's model table.
